title: contractHistoryIdentity
responsibility: Tracks the selected stable uid and observed pre-uid id aliases while excluding different-uid id reuse during committed contract history traversal.

inputs.name: currentContractIdentity.reader
inputs.description: Per-query Git-bound raw contract reader; immutable blobs are cached by Git-returned ids while worktree and index snapshots remain fresh.

inputs.name: currentContractIdentity.unit
inputs.description: Unit id or stable uid to follow through committed history; an empty string selects every contract permitted by the other filters.

inputs.name: selectContractIdentity.context
inputs.description: Per-query reader, options, result accumulator and selected identity. Identity aliases are updated only from observed contract transitions.

inputs.name: selectContractIdentity.before
inputs.description: Earlier stored JSON value or contract snapshot; undefined represents an absent field or contract.

inputs.name: selectContractIdentity.after
inputs.description: Later stored JSON value or contract snapshot; undefined represents an absent field or contract.

outputs.name: currentContractIdentity
outputs.description: Selected uid and id aliases seeded from committed HEAD, or a pending historical-id lookup; an empty unit query returns undefined to select all contracts.

outputs.name: selectContractIdentity
outputs.description: Earlier and later snapshots filtered to the selected uid or observed pre-uid id aliases. Updates identity state at uid introductions, retained-id uid removals and uid-preserving renames.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError or Error
errors.description: Committed HEAD or raw snapshot reads can fail while seeding identity; snapshot diagnostics propagate. Pure snapshot filtering performs no additional reads.
